correctness.rationale: Boolean atomic inputs keep every modal-free Gödel term in {0,1}, so each box at modal depth one has an attained extremum and each diamond contribution lies in {0}∪G_w. Every subset of positive row grades having a maximum is sufficient; necessity follows by selecting any no-maximum subset with a Boolean variable and taking its unattained diamond supremum. The countable rooted height-two frame r→a_n weight1, a_n→b_n weight1/(n+1) has row-positive grade sets each singleton and globally reverse well-ordered grades. With p(b_n)=1, Diamond p(a_n)=1/(n+1)>0, and Box Diamond p(r)=0 without an attaining term. Box not-not Diamond p(r)=1 and not-not Box Diamond p(r)=0, refuting the schema. Independent exact-rational finite truncations have box values 1/(N+1) for N=1,2,3,4,8,16,128; the nonattainment at the infinite limit follows from the explicit sequence, never the finite test.

Restricting to Boolean inputs creates an exact reverse-well-order row criterion, and the depth-two example shows a failure not supplied by finite-model or crisp-edge theorems. A finite ordinal-regrading result cannot imply infinite nonattainment.

value.rationale: Witnessedness of fuzzy modal operators is a mathematically motivated semantic property tied to finite-model results and proof rules. The exact reverse-well-order criterion under Boolean atomic valuations and a minimal depth-two failure on an extremely sparse countable frame isolate the first obstruction to compositional attainment. It differentiates Boolean-input from generally fuzzy valuations and genuinely crisp accessibility without claiming all-depth classification.
